plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Workflow meta package for the global install: GitHub issue and PR skills, development workflow, shared skills, the orchestrator agent and its subagents and the hooks. Stack packages are installed per project.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Meta-package that installs every apm-hub package except apm-tooling in one step. Use it in workspaces that mix several tech stacks.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Agents for a lean issue workflow: orchestrator (primary agent, keeps only phase summaries in context) and the issue-reader, explorer, planner, reviewer, implementer and pr-writer subagents it delegates to, and the /orchestrator skill that runs the orchestrator inline.

plugins.name: hooks
plugins.description: Hooks for Claude Code and Copilot CLI: the subagent stop hook appends a ledger line per finished subagent; the context warning (UserPromptSubmit on Claude Code, postToolUse on Copilot CLI) injects a hand-off hint above 150k tokens; the git guardrails (PreToolUse) deny destructive git commands. OpenCode gets a plugin (ledger and context warning) shipped at .apm/opencode/plugins/apm-hub-hooks.ts; after apm install, copy it to .opencode/plugins/ or ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ by hand until an apmw release with GravionLabs/apmw#38 (open) does it via apmw sanitize -p opencode.

plugins.name: apm-tooling
plugins.description: apm-hub contributor tooling for the skill lifecycle: write, audit, update and slim SKILL.md files.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Issue-driven development workflow: review fan-out, project verification, package installer (apm-install), issue planning with native sub-issues. Depends on github and shared; stack packages are installed per project.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: C#/.NET skills: implementation conventions and review rules, NUnit/NSubstitute/Shouldly testing, solution scaffolding with Central Package Management, MCP server generation.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub workflow skills: issue hierarchy (Epic → Feature → PBI → Task, Bug) with native sub-issues, standalone and batch implementation, pull request creation, release branches (cut, finish), GitHub Project standard (github-project).

plugins.name: ng
plugins.description: Angular 21+ skills: implementation conventions and review rules, Vitest/TestBed testing, component and project scaffolding, NgRx Signal Store, AG Grid Enterprise.

plugins.name: py
plugins.description: Python skills: implementation conventions and review rules, pytest testing with markers and pytest-mock, uv project scaffolding, curated uv CLI reference.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust skills: implementation conventions and review rules (thiserror/anyhow, clippy, rustfmt, unsafe, tokio), cargo test and nextest testing with mockall and proptest.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Shared skills used by all apm-hub packages: tech-stack detection (detect-techstack), language-agnostic implementation rules (implementation), severity-rated code review (code-review), bug diagnosis (diagnose).

plugins.name: ts
plugins.description: TypeScript and Node.js skills: implementation conventions and review rules, Vitest testing, project scaffolding, ESLint/Prettier/Husky setup, pnpm migration, MCP server generation.
